headline: In Rajya Sabha, Kharge Says: Where Are ED and CBI? Rijiju Says: Opposition's Crocodile Tears; Opposition Protests Over Theft Case at Ram Temple; Lok Sabha Adjourned Until Tomorrow
summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman will present the Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill in the Lok Sabha, amid opposition protests that led to adjournment.
why: Tax legislation changes the rules for companies and investors in India, and parliamentary passage affects the country's fiscal and regulatory outlook.
